summary: Robert A. McCabe Jr., Chief Banking Officer of Pinnacle Financial Partners (PNFP), a national commercial bank, purchased 10,013 shares at $99.90 for a total of roughly $1.0 million on July 24, 2026. The purchase brings his holdings to 324,233 shares, a stake large enough that the fresh buy stands out mainly for its round, seven-figure size rather than as a shift in position. Insider purchases of this magnitude can sometimes reflect executive confidence in the bank's near-term outlook, though context on prior trading activity was not available for this filing.
